B_ferritin.interpretation: CDC_chain_e601 is chained point-estimate assay conversion; no direct 2005-to-2023 calibration or coefficient-uncertainty propagation. E170_only is partial bridge sensitivity, not e601 harmonisation.

C_partial_R2.note: Percentile intervals conditional on frozen 2005-08 map; outcome regressions refitted per replicate. Nonnegative partial R2 has boundary bias: use original design-adjusted Wald/Holm tests for significance, not CI exclusion of zero.

D_external.reason: No verified participant-level mapping; no external validation claimed
